stories.title: Indian markets record best weekly gains since 2021
stories.summary: Indian equity markets recorded their strongest weekly gains in nearly six years, with the Nifty 50 climbing 8.58 percent and the BSE Sensex advancing 8.82 percent. The rally, fueled by foreign buying and falling crude oil prices, pushed the Sensex above 81,000 for the first time in months.

stories.title: Retail investors return to stocks after late-session selloff
stories.summary: Retail investors sold a net 151 million dollars in U.S. stocks Thursday as markets fell, with net sales reaching 338 million dollars shortly before the close. Investors then purchased over 100 million dollars in stocks during the final 10 minutes. The selloff was unusually aggressive for retail traders.

stories.summary: Wall Street is bouncing back Friday following Thursday’s sharp selloff, which marked the worst single-day losses since April 2025. Investors are returning to chip stocks amid concerns over data center construction. All three major indexes remain on track for weekly losses despite the recovery.

stories.title: AI stocks help trim weekly market losses
stories.summary: AI stocks rebounded Friday in New York, helping the S&P 500 rise 0.9 percent and trim its weekly loss to 2.1 percent. The recovery followed a worldwide tumble triggered by concerns over AI data-center construction and high borrowing costs. Nvidia rose 3.7 percent after falling 9.3 percent.

stories.title: RBI reports bank credit growth and lower interest rates
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported bank credit grew 19.1 percent year-on-year in September, up from 11.2 percent last year. Services sector credit led with 28.3 percent growth. Weighted average lending rates on fresh rupee loans declined during the same period.

stories.title: RBI proposes tighter rules for agricultural loans
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed stricter documentation for agricultural loans and new priority sector lending calculations. The draft directions aim to strengthen oversight of lending, including gold-backed loans. Comments on the proposals are invited until November 26.

stories.title: Borrowers choose loan terms at reset
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India confirmed that borrowers with floating-rate personal and home loans have the right to choose between higher EMIs, longer tenures, or a combination when loans reset. The choice belongs to the borrower, not the lender, following the October 7 repo rate hike.

stories.title: RBI proposes changes to gold-backed loan verification
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed stricter verification for gold-backed agricultural loans and changes to how banks account for trade bills. The draft directions, released November 5, aim to revise priority sector lending classifications. The central bank is accepting feedback until November 26.

stories.title: India forex reserves decline for second week
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by 2.691 billion dollars to 717.056 billion dollars for the week ending October 30. This follows a 1.269 billion dollar reduction the previous week. Reserves had previously peaked at 785.706 billion dollars on September 4.

stories.title: New cyber rules may increase costs for payment firms
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued new cyber resilience directions for non-bank payment operators, requiring mandatory security monitoring and annual application testing. Large and medium firms must comply immediately, while small operators have until April 2028. Compliance costs are expected to rise.

stories.title: RBI forms committee for financial market policy
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has established a Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets to address policy and operational matters. Chaired by Deputy Governor Rohit Jain, the eight-member group will study market infrastructure, liquidity, and resilience across money and government securities markets.

stories.summary: The government and the Reserve Bank of India have strengthened the regulatory framework for the fintech ecosystem. Measures focus on enhancing cybersecurity, promoting innovation, and protecting digital financial service users. The government continues to engage with regulators to review digital lending and payment aggregator issues.

stories.title: NBFC credit to gold and consumer goods grows
stories.summary: Non-banking finance companies saw credit to gold jewellery grow 66.1 percent to 3.74 lakh crore rupees in September. Credit to consumer durables increased 54.4 percent to 77,896 crore rupees. The data reflects a sharp rise in non-bank lending for these segments.

stories.title: UPI becomes preferred transaction method
stories.summary: A government-backed survey reports that UPI now accounts for 57 percent of transactions, surpassing cash at 38 percent. The report cites ease of use and instant fund transfers as primary drivers for the shift. The study was conducted by an independent agency for the Ministry of Finance.

stories.title: UPI transaction value hits record high
stories.summary: India's UPI platform processed 314.23 lakh crore rupees in transactions during the 2025-26 financial year. The user base reached 55.49 crore as of June 2026. The government noted that the platform has seen sustained growth in both volume and value over the past five financial years.

stories.title: NPCI defends merchant charges in Supreme Court
stories.summary: The NPCI has told the Supreme Court that a revised Merchant Discount Rate framework is necessary to sustain the UPI ecosystem. It maintains that merchants will not be allowed to pass these charges to customers. The fees apply to a small proportion of transactions above 2,000 rupees.

stories.summary: Spain-based Kabilio has raised 10 million euros in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries. stories.title: Small daily savings and the math of long term growth
stories.summary: Investing 50 rupees a day through a mutual fund SIP could build a corpus of over 20 lakh rupees in 25 years, assuming a 10 percent annual return. The strategy relies on consistent habits and time. Compounding is a patient process that requires a quarter century of patience.

stories.title: Hidden costs in no cost EMI offers
stories.summary: Shoppers using credit card EMIs for Diwali should watch for processing fees, GST on interest, lost discounts, and foreclosure charges. These costs can turn a no cost offer into a more expensive purchase. The festive euphoria often makes the fine print harder to read.

stories.title: Hallmarking rules for festive metal idols
stories.summary: Buyers purchasing gold or silver Lakshmi-Ganesha idols for Diwali should verify hallmarking standards. Checking the hallmark is a recommended step before completing the transaction with a jeweller.
